contact.whatsappMessage: Hi Community Unlimited, I'd like to join

hero.note: Free to join · No app to download · Walk-ins welcome
hero.imageAlt: An older woman and a younger woman laughing together at a neighbourhood gathering

purpose.body: Singapore's population is ageing, and support for it sits in too many separate places. Community Unlimited puts it back where it belongs — in the neighbourhood, run by the people who live there.

pillars.title: Connect & contribute
pillars.body: Bringing healthy, active seniors together to create events and shared experiences of their own.

pillars.title: Purpose after retirement
pillars.body: Challenging the stigma around ageing. Asking for help is normal here — and so is giving it.

pillars.title: One-stop simplicity
pillars.body: One community-based way in, instead of a maze of schemes, forms and phone numbers.

pillars.title: Inclusive by design
pillars.body: Adaptable support for every senior — from the tech-savvy to those who'd rather just be told in person.

quote.caption: You can stay vibrant at every stage. That belief runs through everything we run — every walk, every shift, every kopi session.
quote.imageAlt: Neighbours greeting each other with raised hands outside a block of flats

pathway.heading: Five steps from joining to leading
pathway.intro: Everyone starts as a neighbour. Where you go after that is up to you — most people stop at step three, and that's a good place to stop.

steps.label: STEP 01
steps.title: Register
steps.body: Message us on WhatsApp. We'll ask your name, your block, and what you enjoy.

steps.label: STEP 02
steps.title: Train
steps.body: Short, practical sessions run by neighbours who already do the thing.

steps.label: STEP 03
steps.title: Qualify
steps.body: A friendly sign-off so everyone knows you're ready. No exams.

steps.label: STEP 04
steps.title: Deploy
steps.body: Take real shifts at real events, at a pace that suits your week.

steps.label: STEP 05
steps.title: Lead
steps.body: Run your own session and bring the next group of neighbours through.

whatsOn.heading: This week in the neighbourhood
whatsOn.intro: Come once and see. Nothing to sign up for in advance.

events.title: Neighbourhood Morning Walk
events.body: An easy 40 minutes around the estate, then breakfast. Any pace — someone always walks at the back.
events.imageAlt: A group of residents exercising together outside their block in the morning

events.title: Community Barista shift
events.body: Learn the machine, then pull coffee for the morning crowd. Training on the first two shifts.
events.imageAlt: Residents working together at a table at a community activity

events.title: Kopi & Catch-up
events.body: Sit down, talk, meet the block. Bring a neighbour who hasn't been out this week.
events.imageAlt: Neighbours sitting together and chatting in a bright common space

who.heading: Built with seniors, open to everyone around them

tiers.title: Seniors
tiers.body: Active adults aged 60–70 seeking purpose, connection, and a way to keep contributing.
tiers.imageAlt: An older man smiling among a group of younger residents

tiers.title: Families & care networks
tiers.body: Children of ageing parents and the wider network of people helping them day to day.
tiers.imageAlt: A daughter helping her father at home

tiers.title: Stakeholders & partners
tiers.body: Grassroots and government bodies, care providers, and corporate or philanthropic partners.
tiers.imageAlt: Three residents laughing together at a community event

join.heading: Send one message. We'll do the rest.
join.body: Tell us your name and your block. Someone from your neighbourhood will reply, usually the same day.
